description: This file contains the implementation of an Android account authenticator class, handling account addition, credential confirmation, authentication token retrieval, and other account-related operations within the Android framework.

classes.name: Authenticator
classes.description: A custom implementation of AbstractAccountAuthenticator that manages account authentication, token retrieval, and user prompts for account setup and credentials within an Android environment.

methods.name: addAccount
methods.description: Handles adding a new account by initiating the AuthenticatorActivity.

methods.name: confirmCredentials
methods.description: Confirms user credentials; currently unimplemented and returns null.

methods.name: editProperties
methods.description: Allows editing account properties; currently unsupported and throws an exception.

methods.name: getAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication token for the specified account, either by using stored credentials or prompting the user.

methods.name: getAuthTokenLabel
methods.description: Provides a label for the auth token type; returns null indicating no multiple types.

methods.name: hasFeatures
methods.description: Checks support for specific features; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: updateCredentials
methods.description: Updates the user's credentials; currently unimplemented and returns null.
